name: Damion
source:
Perhaps too gentle to be a monster, this Frankenstein creature acts as Fay's anchor and helps them whenever needed. One may wonder how the shy Damion and Fay can be best friends. But opposites attract after all.

[From [url=https://nifty-visuals.itch.io/witches-x-warlocks]itch.io[/url]]
